title: qkd-net-tools: QKD Network Analysis Toolkit
description: Python and R scripts for generating and validating large-scale Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) network topologies under realistic physical and technological constraints. Covers three case studies: Castile and León (generated topology, 100 nodes), Peninsular Spain (generated topology, 950 nodes), and the ADIF dark-fibre railway network (real infrastructure, 485 junction nodes). Includes topology generation via PAM k-medoids clustering, structural analysis (centrality, community detection, k-core decomposition), BB84 decoy-state secret-key-rate modelling, QKD-aware routing, and resilience simulations (random failures and targeted attacks). Developed as part of a doctoral dissertation at the Universidad de Salamanca (2019–2026).
